blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) has temporarily suspended a policy requiring banks to conduct enhanced scrutiny of cash withdrawals exceeding P1 million, allowing legitimate transactions to proceed more smoothly during the Christmas season.
